items.title: Gentlemen ransomware claims Canadian airline
items.summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group claimed an attack on a Canadian airline during the first weeks of September 2026.

items.title: Rhysida hits Berlin Senate network
items.summary: The Rhysida ransomware group breached the network of Berlin's Senate (city-state government) in early September 2026.

items.title: LAPSUS$ resumes "Chapter II" activity
items.summary: The LAPSUS$ extortion group resumed operations under a "Chapter II" banner in September 2026, teasing new victim disclosures.

items.title: AUDIT TEAM extorts four organizations across three countries
items.summary: The data-extortion group AUDIT TEAM listed four victim organizations in South Korea, Germany, and Argentina during the second week of September 2026.

source.name: ASEC — Ransom & Dark Web Issues, Week 2 September 2026

ransomware.note: Named-victim reporting was thinner than usual this cycle; volume-level trend data (Black Kite, VikingCloud) shows 2026 ransomware disclosures continuing to run well above 2025 levels.

items.title: Azure East US outage takes down ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok together
items.summary: A roughly 90-minute Azure East US outage on September 3, 2026 cascaded into simultaneous disruption of ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok, underscoring shared hyperscaler dependency across AI vendors.

outage.note: No additional major hyperscaler outages beyond the Sept 3 Azure East US incident surfaced for this period; Forrester continues to forecast at least two multi-day hyperscaler outages before year-end 2026.

items.title: CISA adds seven exploited flaws tied to reverse shells and crypto miners
items.summary: CISA added seven actively exploited vulnerabilities to its KEV catalog in early September 2026, several linked to attackers deploying reverse shells, Docker environment discovery, and cryptocurrency miners.

items.title: Chromium V8 type-confusion bug (CVE-2026-85046) added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-85046, a Google Chromium V8 type-confusion vulnerability, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, citing it as a frequent attack vector for the federal enterprise.

items.title: Sangoma Switchvox SQL injection (CVE-2026-9586) under active exploitation
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-9586, a SQL injection flaw in Sangoma Switchvox, to its KEV catalog after confirming active exploitation.

items.title: Windows zero-day exploited in the wild despite sub-1% EPSS score
items.summary: One of two Windows zero-days added to CISA's KEV catalog in September 2026 was already being exploited in the wild despite carrying an EPSS exploitation-probability score under 1%, highlighting the limits of purely score-based patch prioritization.

items.title: Nepal holds day of mourning after Himalayan flash floods
items.summary: Nepal held a national day of mourning on September 8, 2026 for victims of flash floods that struck the Himalayan region on August 26, part of an accelerating pattern of severe flood events in the area.

items.title: Grand Canyon flash-flood recovery concludes with final identification
items.summary: Human remains found in the Grand Canyon were identified in September 2026 as the last person missing from deadly late-August flash flooding, closing out the recovery effort.

items.title: M 6.5 earthquake near Nikolski, Alaska (tsunami alert issued)
items.summary: A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck 169 km west of Nikolski, Alaska on September 17, 2026, triggering a tsunami alert (USGS threat level: green).

items.title: M 6.4 earthquake near Kainantu, Papua New Guinea
items.summary: A magnitude 6.4 earthquake struck 49 km NNE of Kainantu, Papua New Guinea on September 20, 2026 (USGS threat level: green, no tsunami warning).

physical.note: No active named hurricanes, typhoons, or wildfire emergencies surfaced for this period; flood recovery in Nepal and the U.S. Southwest dominated physical/natural BC events.
